issue: No validation for invalid/conflicting time ranges
actual: Entered Start Date 2022-01 and End Date 2021-01 (end before start) for a work experience entry. The app accepted this without any error or warning, and the live preview displayed 'Jan 2022 - Jan 2021' as a valid date range.

evidence: Start/End Date fields are native month-type inputs; attempting to set an invalid non-date string ('invalid-date') via direct value assignment resulted in the field being rejected/cleared to empty, confirming only valid YYYY-MM format is accepted.
Clicking 'New Resume' created a blank 'Untitled Resume' editor with empty Contact/Summary/Experience/Education/Skills fields, ready for data entry.

Template tab offers Modern, Classic, and Minimal presets. Selecting 'Classic' instantly changed the live preview layout/style and the resume was saved with template 'classic' shown on the dashboard card.

Successfully entered and edited Contact info (name, email, phone, location, LinkedIn, website), Professional Summary, Work Experience (company, title, dates, description), Education (institution, degree, field, dates, GPA), and Skills (name+level). All fields accepted input and reflected in live preview.

Sections tab allows renaming headings (renamed 'Work Experience' to 'Career History') and reordering sections via up/down arrows (moved Career History above Professional Summary). Both changes applied and reflected instantly in the live preview.
A 'Live Preview' panel is shown alongside the editor at all times, accurately rendering all entered content, chosen template, and section customizations.

Card options menu (Rename/Duplicate/Delete) on dashboard. 'Duplicate' created 'UX Designer Resume - TechCo (Copy)'; 'Rename' opened a dialog with a textbox and Save button, successfully renamed the copy to 'UX Designer Resume - StartupInc'.

Dashboard lists multiple distinct saved resume versions (5 total after testing): UX Designer Resume - StartupInc, UX Designer Resume - TechCo, Product Designer Resume, Marketing Manager Resume, Software Engineer Resume - each with its own template and update date.

Search box filtering by title 'Marketing' correctly narrowed the list to only 'Marketing Manager Resume'. Sort dropdown 'Title A-Z' correctly reordered all 5 resumes alphabetically by title. 'Newest First'/'Oldest First' date-based sort options also present.

Changed Full Name on the duplicated resume 'UX Designer Resume - StartupInc' to 'Jane Smith-StartupCopy'; re-opening the original 'UX Designer Resume - TechCo' still showed unchanged Full Name 'Jane Smith', confirming independent storage per version.

All entered fields (name, email, phone, location, linkedin, website, summary, experience with dates/description, education with GPA, skills) were fully retained and displayed correctly both in the editor and duplicated copy.

Every field edit (contact info, summary, experience, education, skills, template change, section rename/reorder/visibility toggle) was reflected in the Live Preview panel immediately within the same snapshot capture, with no observed delay or rendering errors.
Reordering (move up arrow) and renaming a section heading, plus toggling section visibility switch, all applied instantly and correctly to the live preview without needing an explicit save or reload.

issue: Saved resumes are not persisted across page reloads
actual: Created and saved two new resumes ('UX Designer Resume - TechCo' and its duplicate/rename 'UX Designer Resume - StartupInc') which appeared correctly on the dashboard. After reloading the application at http://localhost:7005/, both newly created resumes disappeared entirely from the dashboard; only the original 3 preset resumes (Product Designer, Marketing Manager, Software Engineer) remained. This indicates data is held only in in-memory/session state and is lost on re-access/reload.

issue: No user feedback/confirmation shown after saving
actual: Editing resume content and navigating back (auto-save), as well as renaming a resume via the dialog's 'Save' button, both persisted the changes but produced no visible toast, banner, or confirmation message. The page's 'Notifications' region remained an empty list after each save action, giving the user no explicit feedback that the save succeeded.

evidence: Opened 'Product Designer Resume' (Minimal template) with full content: header/contact, professional summary, 2 experience entries with dates and descriptions, 5 skill tags, and education entry. All sections rendered completely and cleanly in the Live Preview with no truncation, overlap, or missing elements.
The title 'Data Analyst Resume' shown on the dashboard card matched exactly the title displayed in the editor's header ('Data Analyst Resume') when opened, confirming consistency across pages/views.
